english: Use case: background-extraction. Edit the supplied RPG portrait into a dialogue sprite with a genuinely transparent RGBA background. Preserve the exact character identity, face, hairstyle, expression, pose, hands, clothing, carried objects, colors, painterly rendering and original framing. Keep the entire existing character silhouette and carried equipment opaque, with clean detailed alpha edges around hair and clothing. All surrounding background becomes transparent. Output one isolated character image.
japanese: 元のRPG肖像を編集し、実際のRGBA透過背景を持つ会話用立ち絵にします。人物の同一性、顔、髪型、表情、姿勢、手、服装、持ち物、色、描画タッチ、元の構図を保持します。人物と装備は不透明に保ち、髪や衣服の輪郭を精細なアルファで表現します。周囲の背景を透明にし、人物単体の画像を出力します。
